// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
function el(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
function cap(s) { return s ? s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : ''; }
function isDev() { return !S.token || S.token === 'dev'; }

function clearTimers() {
  if (S._pollTimer) { clearInterval(S._pollTimer); S._pollTimer = null; }
  if (S._msgTimer) { clearInterval(S._msgTimer); S._msgTimer = null; }
}

let _toastT;
function toast(msg, type = 'info') {
  const t = el('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.className = type === 'err' ? 'toast-err' : type === 'ok' ? 'toast-ok' : '';
  t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(_toastT);
  _toastT = setTimeout(() => { t.classList.remove('show'); t.className = ''; }, 3500);
}

function log(label, data) {
  if (isDev()) console.log(`[WH] ${label}:`, data);
}

function logErr(label, err) {
  console.error(`[WH ERROR] ${label}:`, err);
  // In production, you could send to Sentry here
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API — defensive wrapper with retries and user feedback
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
async function apiFetch(url, opts = {}, { retries = 1, silent = false } = {}) {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type':'application/json', ...(opts.headers||{}) };
  let lastErr;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= retries; attempt++) {
    try {
      const r = await fetch(url, { ...opts, headers });
      if (!r.ok) {
        const e = new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
        e.status = r.status;
        e.url = url;
        throw e;
      }
      return await r.json();
    } catch (err) {
      lastErr = err;
      if (attempt < retries) {
        await wait(1000 * (attempt + 1)); // exponential-ish backoff
      }
    }
  }

  logErr(`apiFetch failed: ${url}`, lastErr);
  if (!silent) {
    toast('Connection issue — check your internet and try again', 'err');
  }
  throw lastErr;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SCREEN MANAGEMENT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
async function showScreen(name, ctx = {}) {
  if (ctx.token) S.token = ctx.token;
  if (ctx.slug)  S.slug  = ctx.slug;

  const cur = document.querySelector('.screen.active');
  if (cur) {
    cur.classList.add('exit');
    await wait(200);
    cur.classList.remove('active', 'exit');
  }

  const next = el('screen-' + name);
  if (!next) { logErr('Screen not found', name); return; }
  next.classList.add('active');
  S.screen = name;

  // Call screen-specific init
  const inits = { init: onInit, experience: onExperience, confirm: onConfirm, processing: onProcessing, dashboard: onDashboard };
  try {
    await inits[name]?.(ctx);
  } catch (err) {
    logErr(`Screen init failed: ${name}`, err);
    toast('Something went wrong loading this screen', 'err');
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SCREEN: INIT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function onInit(ctx) {
  clearTimers();
  el('initActions').style.display = 'none';
  S._msgIdx = 0;
  setInitMsg(0);

  S._msgTimer = setInterval(() => {
    S._msgIdx = (S._msgIdx + 1) % INIT_MSGS.length;
    setInitMsg(S._msgIdx);
  }, CONFIG.MSG_ROTATE_INTERVAL);

  if (isDev()) return;

  const deadline = Date.now() + CONFIG.INIT_TIMEOUT;
  let failStreak = 0;

  S._pollTimer = setInterval(async () => {
    try {
      const d = await apiFetch(`/build-status?token=${S.token}`, {}, { silent: true });
      failStreak = 0;

      if (d.slug) S.slug = d.slug;

      if (d.status === 'preview_ready' || d.status === 'ready') {
        clearTimers();
        showScreen('experience', { slug: S.slug || d.slug, token: S.token });
      } else if (d.status === 'failed') {
        clearTimers();
        showInitError('Build failed', "We couldn't build your preview. Tap to retry or contact support.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      failStreak++;
      if (failStreak >= 3) {
        clearTimers();
        showInitError('Connection lost', "Can't reach our servers. Check your connection and tap to retry.");
      }
    }

    if (Date.now() > deadline) {
      clearTimers();
      showInitTimeout();
    }
  }, CONFIG.POLL_INTERVAL);
}

function setInitMsg(i) {
  const m = INIT_MSGS[i];
  el('initStatus').textContent = m.s;
  el('initSub').textContent = m.b;
}

function showInitError(status, sub) {
  clearTimers();
  el('initStatus').textContent = status;
  el('initSub').textContent = sub;
  el('initActions').style.display = 'flex';
}

function showInitTimeout() {
  el('initStatus').textContent = 'Taking longer than usual';
  el('initSub').textContent = "We're still working. You'll get a WhatsApp when it's ready — you can close this tab.";
  el('initActions').style.display = 'flex';
}

function retryInit() {
  el('initActions').style.display = 'none';
  onInit({ token: S.token });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SCREEN: EXPERIENCE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
async function onExperience(ctx) {
  // Reset card state for fresh entry
  S.currentCard = 0;
  S.rebuildDone = false;
  S.rebuildFailed = false;

  buildIndGrid();
  updatePlanTickets(S.selectedPlan);
  updateCardUI();
  slideCardsTo(0);

  // Setup iframe
  const frame = el('siteFrame');
  const frameWrap = el('frameWrap');

  if (isDev()) {
    frame.src = 'about:blank';
    frameWrap.classList.remove('frame-loading', 'frame-error');
    return;
  }

  if (!S.slug) {
    frameWrap.classList.add('frame-error');
    frameWrap.setAttribute('data-error', "We couldn't find your preview. Please start over.");
    logErr('Experience: no slug', { token: S.token });
    return;
  }

  // Load iframe with proper handlers
  const previewUrl = `/${S.slug}/raw/?page=index`;
  frameWrap.classList.add('frame-loading');
  frameWrap.classList.remove('frame-error');
  S._iframeLoading = true;

  frame.onload = () => {
    S._iframeLoading = false;
    frameWrap.classList.remove('frame-loading');
    log('iframe loaded', previewUrl);
  };

  frame.onerror = () => {
    S._iframeLoading = false;
    frameWrap.classList.remove('frame-loading');
    frameWrap.classList.add('frame-error');
    frameWrap.setAttribute('data-error', "Preview couldn't load. Tap to retry.");
    logErr('iframe error', previewUrl);
  };

  frame.src = previewUrl;

  // Load preview meta in background
  try {
    const d = await apiFetch(`/preview-meta?slug=${S.slug}`, {}, { silent: true });
    S.previewMeta = d;

    if (d.businessName) el('expBiz').textContent = d.businessName;
    if (d.area) { el('areaInput').value = d.area; S.cards.area = d.area; }
    if (d.industry) {
      S.cards.industry = d.industry.toLowerCase();
      // Select matching tile
      document.querySelectorAll('.ind-tile').forEach(t => {
        t.classList.toggle('sel', t.dataset.ind === S.cards.industry);
      });
    }
    if (d.package) selectPlan(d.package);
    if (d.taglines?.length) {
      S.cards.tagline = d.taglines[0];
    }
    populateSvc(d.industry?.toLowerCase() || '_');
  } catch (err) {
    logErr('preview-meta failed', err);
    // Non-fatal: cards work without prefill
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CARD SYSTEM — horizontal slide with transform
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function slideCardsTo(idx) {
  const track = el('cardsTrack');
  if (!track) return;
  track.style.transform = `translateX(-${idx * 100}%)`;
}

function updateCardUI() {
  const idx = S.currentCard;
  const tot = CARDS.length;

  // Progress
  el('expCounter').textContent = `Step ${idx + 1} of ${tot}`;
  el('expProgFill').style.width = `${Math.round(((idx + 1) / tot) * 100)}%`;

  const msgs = [
    'Start here — every answer improves your site',
    'Location shapes how your site reads',
    'Personality makes copy come alive',
    'Services locked in — homepage taking shape',
    'The detail that makes visitors convert',
    'Visuals make your site feel real',
    'Almost done — make it yours',
  ];
  el('expProgMsg').textContent = msgs[idx] || '';

  // Buttons
  const back = el('btnBack');
  back.disabled = idx === 0;
  back.style.opacity = idx === 0 ? '0.35' : '1';

  const next = el('btnNext');
  if (idx === tot - 2) {
    next.textContent = 'Build my site';
    next.classList.add('build');
  } else if (idx === tot - 1) {
    next.textContent = 'Checkout';
    next.classList.remove('build');
  } else {
    next.textContent = 'Next';
    next.classList.remove('build');
  }

  // Populate taglines when reaching style card
  if (CARDS[idx] === 'style') populateTaglines();
}

function cardNext() {
  gatherCard();

  const idx = S.currentCard;
  const cardName = CARDS[idx];

  // Visuals card → trigger rebuild
  if (cardName === 'visuals') {
    triggerRebuild();
    return;
  }

  // Style card (last) → checkout
  if (idx >= CARDS.length - 1) {
    if (!S.rebuildDone) {
      toast('Please wait for your site to finish building', 'err');
      return;
    }
    goToConfirm();
    return;
  }

  // Normal advance
  S.currentCard = idx + 1;
  slideCardsTo(S.currentCard);
  updateCardUI();
  fireIntakePreview();
}

function cardBack() {
  if (S.currentCard <= 0) return;
  S.currentCard--;
  slideCardsTo(S.currentCard);
  updateCardUI();
}

function gatherCard() {
  const name = CARDS[S.currentCard];
  switch (name) {
    case 'industry':
      const custom = el('indCustom').value.trim();
      if (custom) S.cards.industry = custom.toLowerCase();
      break;
    case 'area':
      S.cards.area = el('areaInput').value.trim();
      S.cards.audience = el('audienceInput').value.trim();
      break;
    case 'services':
      S.cards.cta = el('ctaInput').value.trim() || 'Get a Quote';
      break;
    case 'differentiators':
      S.cards.diff1 = el('diff1').value.trim();
      S.cards.diff2 = el('diff2').value.trim();
      S.cards.diff3 = el('diff3').value.trim();
      S.cards.testimonial = el('testimonial').value.trim();
      break;
  }
}

// Touch swipe on cards
(function initSwipe() {
  let sx = 0, sy = 0, st = 0;
  const wrap = el('cardsTrackWrap');
  if (!wrap) return;

  wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
    if (e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    sx = e.touches[0].clientX;
    sy = e.touches[0].clientY;
    st = Date.now();
  }, { passive: true });

  wrap.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
    if (!sx) return;
    const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - sx;
    const dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - sy;
    const dt = Date.now() - st;
    sx = 0;

    // Only handle horizontal swipes, ignore vertical scroll
    if (Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy)) return;
    if (Math.abs(dx) < 50 || dt > 500) return;

    if (dx < 0) cardNext();
    else cardBack();
  }, { passive: true });
})();

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// INDUSTRY GRID
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function buildIndGrid() {
  const g = el('indGrid');
  if (!g) return;
  g.innerHTML = '';

  INDUSTRIES.forEach(({ i, l }) => {
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'ind-tile';
    t.dataset.ind = l.toLowerCase();
    t.innerHTML = `<div class="ind-tile-icon">${i}</div><div>${l}</div>`;
    if (S.cards.industry === l.toLowerCase()) t.classList.add('sel');

    t.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.ind-tile').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('sel'));
      t.classList.add('sel');
      S.cards.industry = l.toLowerCase();
      el('indCustom').value = '';
      populateSvc(l.toLowerCase());
    });

    g.appendChild(t);
  });
}

function handleCustomIndustry() {
  const v = el('indCustom').value.trim();
  if (!v) return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.ind-tile').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('sel'));
  S.cards.industry = v.toLowerCase();
  populateSvc('_');
}

function populateSvc(ind) {
  const svcs = SVC_DEFAULTS[ind] || SVC_DEFAULTS._;
  S.cards.services = svcs.slice(0, 3);

  const wrap = el('servicesChips');
  if (!wrap) return;
  wrap.innerHTML = '';

  svcs.forEach(s => {
    const c = document.createElement('div');
    c.className = 'chip sel';
    c.textContent = s;
    c.addEventListener('click', () => {
      c.classList.toggle('sel');
      if (c.classList.contains('sel')) {
        if (!S.cards.services.includes(s)) S.cards.services.push(s);
      } else {
        S.cards.services = S.cards.services.filter(x => x !== s);
      }
    });
    wrap.appendChild(c);
  });
}

function addCustomService(e) {
  if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
  const v = e.target.value.trim();
  if (!v) return;

  S.cards.services.push(v);
  const wrap = el('servicesChips');
  const c = document.createElement('div');
  c.className = 'chip sel';
  c.textContent = v;
  c.addEventListener('click', () => {
    c.classList.toggle('sel');
    if (!c.classList.contains('sel')) {
      S.cards.services = S.cards.services.filter(x => x !== v);
    }
  });
  wrap.appendChild(c);
  e.target.value = '';
}

function selectVibe(v, el_) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.vibe-opt').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('sel'));
  el_.classList.add('sel');
  S.cards.vibe = v;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// UPLOADS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function handleLogoUpload(input) {
  const f = input.files[0];
  if (!f) return;

  // Validate
  if (f.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
    toast('Logo too large — max 5MB', 'err');
    return;
  }

  const r = new FileReader();
  r.onload = e => {
    const z = el('logoZone');
    z.innerHTML = `<img class="uz-img" src="${e.target.result}"><div class="uz-title" style="color:var(--green)">✓ Logo added</div><div class="uz-sub">${f.name}</div>`;
    z.classList.add('has-file');
  };
  r.onerror = () => toast('Could not read logo file', 'err');
  r.readAsDataURL(f);

  if (isDev()) return;

  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append('slug', S.slug);
  fd.append('token', S.token || '');
  fd.append('type', 'logo');
  fd.append('file', f);

  fetch('/upload-assets', { method: 'POST', body: fd })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(d => {
      if (d.url) {
        S.cards.logo = d.url;
        toast('Logo uploaded ✓', 'ok');
      } else {
        throw new Error('No URL in response');
      }
    })
    .catch(err => {
      logErr('Logo upload failed', err);
      toast('Logo upload failed — try again', 'err');
    });
}

function handlePhotoUpload(input) {
  const files = Array.from(input.files);
  if (!files.length) return;

  files.forEach(f => {
    if (f.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toast(`"${f.name}" too large — max 5MB`, 'err');
      return;
    }

    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = e => {
      const strip = el('photoStrip');
      const img = document.createElement('img');
      img.className = 'photo-thumb';
      img.src = e.target.result;
      img.title = f.name;
      strip.insertBefore(img, strip.firstChild);
    };
    r.onerror = () => toast(`Could not read ${f.name}`, 'err');
    r.readAsDataURL(f);

    if (isDev()) return;

    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('slug', S.slug);
    fd.append('token', S.token || '');
    fd.append('type', 'photo');
    fd.append('file', f);

    fetch('/upload-assets', { method: 'POST', body: fd })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => {
        if (d.url) S.cards.photos.push(d.url);
      })
      .catch(err => logErr('Photo upload failed', err));
  });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// REBUILD — with proper success/failure tracking
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
async function triggerRebuild() {
  const ov = el('rebuildOv');
  const sub = el('rbSub');
  const actions = el('rbActions');

  ov.classList.add('show');
  sub.textContent = 'This takes about 30 seconds';
  actions.style.display = 'none';
  S.rebuildDone = false;
  S.rebuildFailed = false;

  if (isDev()) {
    await wait(2000);
    ov.classList.remove('show');
    S.rebuildDone = true;
    S.currentCard = CARDS.indexOf('style');
    slideCardsTo(S.currentCard);
    updateCardUI();
    updateCheckout();
    toast('Preview rebuilt (dev mode) ✓', 'ok');
    return;
  }

  try {
    await apiFetch('/trigger-rebuild', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        slug: S.slug,
        token: S.token,
        cards: { ...S.cards },
        assets: { logo: S.cards.logo, photos: S.cards.photos },
        palette: S.cards.palette,
        font: S.cards.font,
        tagline: S.cards.tagline,
      })
    });

    // Poll for completion
    let attempts = 0;
    const pollInterval = setInterval(async () => {
      attempts++;
      try {
        const d = await apiFetch(`/build-status?token=${S.token}`, {}, { silent: true });

        if (d.status === 'preview_ready') {
          clearInterval(pollInterval);
          ov.classList.remove('show');
          S.rebuildDone = true;
          S.rebuildFailed = false;

          // Reload iframe
          const frame = el('siteFrame');
          if (frame) frame.src = `/${S.slug}/raw/?page=index&t=${Date.now()}`;

          // Advance to style card
          S.currentCard = CARDS.indexOf('style');
          slideCardsTo(S.currentCard);
          updateCardUI();
          updateCheckout();
          toast('Your site is ready ✓', 'ok');
          return;
        }

        if (d.status === 'failed') {
          clearInterval(pollInterval);
          sub.textContent = 'Build failed — tap to retry or contact support';
          actions.style.display = 'flex';
          S.rebuildFailed = true;
          logErr('Rebuild failed', d);
          return;
        }

        // Update status message
        if (attempts % 5 === 0) {
          sub.textContent = `Still building… (${attempts * 2}s)`;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        logErr('Rebuild poll error', err);
      }

      if (attempts >= CONFIG.REBUILD_MAX_POLLS) {
        clearInterval(pollInterval);
        sub.textContent = 'Build is taking longer than expected — tap to retry';
        actions.style.display = 'flex';
        S.rebuildFailed = true;
      }
    }, CONFIG.POLL_INTERVAL);

  } catch (err) {
    logErr('Trigger rebuild failed', err);
    sub.textContent = "Couldn't start build — tap to retry";
    actions.style.display = 'flex';
    S.rebuildFailed = true;
  }
}

function retryRebuild() {
  el('rbActions').style.display = 'none';
  triggerRebuild();
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STYLE CARD — palette & taglines
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function populateTaglines() {
  const list = el('taglineList');
  if (!list) return;

  const tags = S.previewMeta?.taglines || [];
  if (!tags.length) {
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="card-hint">Taglines loading…</div>';
    return;
  }

  list.innerHTML = '';
  tags.forEach((t, i) => {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'tl-opt' + (i === 0 && !S.cards.tagline ? ' sel' : '');
    d.textContent = t;
    if (i === 0 && !S.cards.tagline) S.cards.tagline = t;

    d.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tl-opt').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('sel'));
      d.classList.add('sel');
      S.cards.tagline = t;
      sendPatch();
    });

    list.appendChild(d);
  });
}

function pickPalette(pal, el_) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.pal-swatch').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('sel'));
  el_.classList.add('sel');
  S.cards.palette = pal;
  sendPatch();
}

async function sendPatch() {
  if (isDev() || !S.slug) return;

  const ov = el('patchOverlay');
  ov.classList.add('show');

  try {
    await apiFetch('/patch-preview', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        slug: S.slug,
        token: S.token,
        patch: {
          palette: S.cards.palette || 'ocean',
          tagline: S.cards.tagline || '',
        }
      })
    }, { silent: true });

    // Reload iframe
    const frame = el('siteFrame');
    if (frame) frame.src = `/${S.slug}/raw/?page=index&t=${Date.now()}`;

    await wait(600);
    ov.classList.remove('show');
  } catch (err) {
    logErr('Patch failed', err);
    ov.classList.remove('show');
    toast("Couldn't apply change — try again", 'err');
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// INTAKE PREVIEW — fire and forget with logging
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function fireIntakePreview() {
  if (isDev() || !S.slug) return;

  fetch('/intake-preview', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      slug: S.slug,
      token: S.token,
      card: S.currentCard,
      biz: S.previewMeta?.businessName || '',
      industry: S.cards.industry || '',
      area: S.cards.area || '',
      vibe: S.cards.vibe || '',
      services: S.cards.services.join(', '),
      differentiators: [S.cards.diff1, S.cards.diff2, S.cards.diff3].filter(Boolean).join('; '),
      audience: S.cards.audience || '',
    })
  })
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(d => {
    if (d.preview) {
      // Post to iframe if same-origin
      try {
        const frame = el('siteFrame');
        if (frame?.contentWindow) {
          frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: 'wh-preview', data: d.preview }, '*');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Cross-origin or iframe not ready — fine to ignore
      }
    }
  })
  .catch(err => logErr('Intake preview failed', err));
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TICKETS + CHECKOUT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function selectPlan(plan, tileEl) {
  const wasSelected = tileEl?.classList.contains('sel');
  S.selectedPlan = plan;
  updatePlanTickets(plan);
  updateCheckout();
  if (wasSelected) showPlanPopover(plan);
}

function updatePlanTickets(plan) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.ticket').forEach(t => {
    t.classList.toggle('sel', t.dataset.plan === plan);
  });
}

function updateCheckout() {
  const btn = el('checkoutBtn');
  const canCheckout = S.currentCard >= CARDS.length - 1 && S.selectedPlan && S.rebuildDone && !S.rebuildFailed;
  btn.disabled = !canCheckout;

  if (canCheckout) {
    btn.textContent = 'Continue to checkout →';
  } else if (S.rebuildFailed) {
    btn.textContent = 'Build failed — retry above';
  } else if (!S.rebuildDone) {
    btn.textContent = 'Finish cards to continue';
  } else {
    btn.textContent = 'Continue to checkout →';
  }
}

function goToConfirm() {
  showScreen('confirm', {});
}

function showPlanPopover(plan) {
  const p = PLANS[plan];
  el('popName').textContent = `${p.name} — R${p.price}/mo`;
  el('popBadge').textContent = p.badge;
  el('popFeats').innerHTML = p.feats.map(f =>
    `<div class="feat-row"><span class="feat-check">✓</span>${f}</div>`
  ).join('');
  el('planPopover').classList.add('open');
  el('popoverOv').classList.add('show');
  // Allow scroll within popover but not body
  el('planPopover').style.overflowY = 'auto';
  el('planPopover').style.maxHeight = '70vh';
}

function closePopover() {
  el('planPopover').classList.remove('open');
  el('popoverOv').classList.remove('show');
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SCREEN: CONFIRM
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function onConfirm() {
  const p = PLANS[S.selectedPlan] || PLANS.standard;
  el('cPlan').textContent = p.name;
  el('cPrice').textContent = 'R' + p.price;
  el('cDomain').textContent = S.slug ? `${S.slug}.co.za` : '—';
  el('cEmail').textContent = S.selectedPlan === 'express' ? 'Not included' : '1 account';
  el('payBtn').textContent = `Pay R${p.price} — Go Live 🚀`;
  el('confirmSub').textContent = S.slug ? `${S.slug}.co.za — free domain + setup included` : 'Free domain + setup included';
}

function clearPromo() {
  el('promoMsg').textContent = '';
  el('promoMsg').className = '';
}

function applyPromo() {
  const code = el('promoInput').value.trim().toUpperCase();
  const m = el('promoMsg');

  if (PROMO_CODES[code] !== undefined) {
    const p = PLANS[S.selectedPlan];
    const disc = PROMO_CODES[code];
    const newPrice = disc === 1.0 ? 0 : Math.round(p.price * (1 - disc));

    el('cPrice').textContent = newPrice === 0 ? 'Free first month' : 'R' + newPrice;
    el('payBtn').textContent = newPrice === 0 ? 'Activate — Go Live 🚀' : `Pay R${newPrice} — Go Live 🚀`;
    m.textContent = disc === 1.0 ? '🎉 First month free!' : `🎉 ${Math.round(disc * 100)}% off applied`;
    m.className = 'ok';
  } else {
    m.textContent = 'Code not recognised';
    m.className = 'err';
  }
}

async function processPayment() {
  if (isDev()) {
    showScreen('processing', { token: 'dev' });
    return;
  }

  const btn = el('payBtn');
  const originalText = btn.textContent;
  btn.textContent = 'Connecting to PayFast…';
  btn.disabled = true;

  const p = PLANS[S.selectedPlan];

  try {
    const d = await apiFetch('/go-live-link', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        token: S.token,
        slug: S.slug,
        plan: S.selectedPlan,
        retainer: p.price,
        choices: {
          palette: S.cards.palette,
          font: S.cards.font,
          tagline: S.cards.tagline,
          logo: S.cards.logo,
          photo: S.cards.photos[0] || null,
        }
      })
    });

    if (d.redirectUrl) {
      window.location.href = d.redirectUrl;
    } else {
      throw new Error('No redirect URL');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    logErr('Payment init failed', err);
    btn.textContent = originalText;
    btn.disabled = false;
    toast("Couldn't reach payments — check connection and try again", 'err');
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SCREEN: PROCESSING
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function onProcessing(ctx) {
  el('procStatus').textContent = 'Confirming your payment';
  el('procSub').textContent = 'This usually takes a few seconds';
  el('procAction').style.display = 'none';

  if (isDev()) {
    setTimeout(() => showScreen('dashboard', { token: 'dev' }), 2000);
    return;
  }

  let attempts = 0;
  const timer = setInterval(async () => {
    attempts++;

    try {
      const d = await apiFetch(`/client-status?token=${S.token}`, {}, { silent: true });
      if (d.slug) S.slug = d.slug;

      if (d.status === 'live') {
        clearInterval(timer);
        showScreen('dashboard', { token: S.token });
        return;
      }

      if (d.status === 'failed') {
        clearInterval(timer);
        el('procStatus').textContent = 'Payment not confirmed';
        el('procSub').textContent = 'Something went wrong. Tap to try again or contact support.';
        el('procAction').style.display = 'flex';
        return;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      logErr('Processing poll error', err);
    }

    if (attempts >= CONFIG.PROCESSING_MAX_POLLS) {
      clearInterval(timer);
      el('procStatus').textContent = 'Still confirming';
      el('procSub').textContent = "We'll send you a WhatsApp when ready. You can close this tab.";
      el('procAction').style.display = 'flex';
    }
  }, CONFIG.POLL_INTERVAL);
}

function retryProcessing() {
  el('procAction').style.display = 'none';
  onProcessing({});
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SCREEN: DASHBOARD
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
async function onDashboard(ctx) {
  if (isDev()) {
    renderDash({
      businessName: 'Demo Business',
      slug: 'demo-business',
      domain: 'demo-business.co.za',
      liveUrl: 'https://demo-business.co.za',
      package: 'standard',
      status: 'live',
      retainer: 999,
      nextInvoiceDate: '2026-06-25',
      revisions: { used: 0, limit: 2, paidCost: 199 },
      email: { included: 1, addonAvailable: true, addonCost: 200 },
      gallery: null,
      referral: { enabled: true, link: 'https://websitehub.co.za?ref=demo-business', sent: 3, conversions: 1, rewardMonths: 1 },
      analytics: { enabled: true, slug: 'demo-business' },
      upgradeOffers: [{ to: 'premium', delta: 500 }]
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const d = await apiFetch(`/manage-panel?token=${S.token}`);
    S.dashData = d;
    renderDash(d);
  } catch (err) {
    logErr('Dashboard load failed', err);
    if (err.status === 404) {
      location.href = '/start';
    } else {
      toast("Couldn't load dashboard — check connection and try again", 'err');
    }
  }
}

function renderDash(d) {
  S.dashData = d;
  el('dashBiz').textContent = d.businessName || 'Your business';

  const inv = d.nextInvoiceDate
    ? new Date(d.nextInvoiceDate).toLocaleDateString('en-ZA', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })
    : '—';

  el('sInvoice').textContent = inv;
  el('sReferrals').textContent = d.referral?.conversions ?? 0;

  const rl = d.revisions?.limit;
  el('qRevSub').textContent = rl === null ? 'Unlimited' : `${rl || 0} free/month`;
  el('qEmailSub').textContent = d.email?.included > 0
    ? `${d.email.included} account${d.email.included > 1 ? 's' : ''}`
    : 'Not included';

  if (!d.gallery) el('qGallery').style.opacity = '.5';

  if (d.upgradeOffers?.length) {
    el('upgradeSection').style.display = 'block';
    el('upgradeCards').innerHTML = d.upgradeOffers.map(o => `
      <div class="up-card">
        <div class="up-label">Upgrade to ${cap(o.to)}</div>
        <div class="up-title">${upTitle(o.to)}</div>
        <div class="up-sub">${upDesc(o.to)}</div>
        <div class="up-btn" onclick="startUpgrade('${o.to}',${o.delta})">+ R${o.delta}/mo →</div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  } else {
    el('upgradeSection').style.display = 'none';
  }

  // Site tab
  el('siteLiveUrl').textContent = d.liveUrl || '—';

  // Email tab
  if (d.email?.included > 0) {
    el('emailAddr').textContent = `hello@${d.domain || d.slug + '.co.za'}`;
    el('emailUpsell').style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    el('emailPanel').innerHTML = '';
    el('emailUpsell').style.display = 'block';
  }

  // Revisions tab
  const used = d.revisions?.used || 0;
  const limit = d.revisions?.limit ?? 2;
  el('revCount').textContent = `${used} / ${limit === null ? '∞' : limit} used`;
  el('revFill').style.width = limit === null ? '0%' : `${Math.min(100, (used / limit) * 100)}%`;

  // Account tab
  el('acctPlan').textContent = cap(d.package || 'standard');
  el('acctInvoice').textContent = `Next invoice: ${inv} · R${d.retainer}/mo`;

  if (d.referral) {
    el('refLink').textContent = d.referral.link || '—';
    el('refSent').textContent = d.referral.sent || 0;
    el('refConv').textContent = d.referral.conversions || 0;
    el('refMonths').textContent = d.referral.rewardMonths || 0;
  }

  // Analytics
  if (d.analytics?.enabled) {
    fetchAnalytics(d.analytics.slug);
  }
}

async function fetchAnalytics(slug) {
  try {
    const d = await apiFetch(`/analytics?slug=${slug}&range=7d`, {}, { silent: true });
    el('sVisits').textContent = d.totals?.visits ?? '—';
    el('sWaTaps').textContent = d.totals?.waTaps ?? '—';
    el('trafficChart').textContent = `${d.totals?.visits || 0} visits · ${d.totals?.uniqueVisitors || 0} unique · ${d.totals?.waTaps || 0} WA taps`;

    if (d.topPages?.length) {
      el('topPagesList').innerHTML = d.topPages.map(p =>
        `<div class="list-row"><div class="list-lbl">${p.path}</div><div>${p.visits}</div></div>`
      ).join('');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    logErr('Analytics fetch failed', err);
    el('trafficChart').textContent = 'Analytics unavailable';
  }
}

function switchTab(tab) {
  S.activeTab = tab;
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  el('tab-' + tab)?.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelector(`.tab[data-tab="${tab}"]`)?.classList.add('active');
  el('dashContent').scrollTop = 0;
}

function openSite() {
  const u = S.dashData?.liveUrl;
  if (u) window.open(u, '_blank');
}

function galleryTap() {
  if (!S.dashData?.gallery) {
    toast('Gallery is a Premium feature — upgrade to unlock', 'err');
  }
}

async function submitRevision() {
  const txt = el('revText').value.trim();
  if (!txt) {
    toast('Describe what you want changed', 'err');
    return;
  }

  if (isDev()) {
    toast('Revision submitted (demo mode) ✓', 'ok');
    el('revText').value = '';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const d = await apiFetch('/submit-revision', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: S.token, message: txt, type: 'free' })
    });

    if (d.success) {
      toast("Request submitted ✓ We'll update your site within 24hrs", 'ok');
      el('revText').value = '';
    } else if (d.paymentRequired) {
      toast('Revision allowance exhausted — upgrade to continue', 'err');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    logErr('Revision submit failed', err);
    toast("Couldn't submit — check connection and try again", 'err');
  }
}

function copyRef() {
  const link = el('refLink').textContent || '';
  if (!link || link === '—') {
    toast('No referral link available', 'err');
    return;
  }
  navigator.clipboard?.writeText(link)
    .then(() => toast('Referral link copied! 🎉', 'ok'))
    .catch(() => toast('Could not copy link', 'err'));
}

function startUpgrade(to, delta) {
  toast(`Upgrade to ${cap(to)} — coming soon`, 'info');
}

async function cancelSite() {
  if (!confirm('Are you sure? Your site will be deactivated at the end of this billing period.')) return;

  if (isDev()) {
    toast('Cancellation (demo mode)', 'info');
    return;
  }

  try {
    await apiFetch('/cancel-site', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: S.token })
    });
    toast('Cancellation received. Confirmation via WhatsApp.', 'ok');
  } catch (err) {
    logErr('Cancel failed', err);
    toast("Couldn't process — contact support", 'err');
  }
}

function upTitle(to) {
  return {
    premium: 'Unlimited revisions + photo gallery',
    standard: 'Business email + 5 pages'
  }[to] || 'Upgrade your plan';
}

function upDesc(to) {
  return {
    premium: 'Two email accounts, unlimited changes, gallery add-on.',
    standard: 'A professional email address and room to grow.'
  }[to] || '';
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BOOTSTRAP ROUTER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
async function bootstrap() {
  const path = location.pathname;
  const slug = (path.match(/\/experience\/([^/]+)/) || [])[1];
  const token = (path.match(/\/(manage|build|verify)\/([^/]+)/) || [])[2];

  if (token && path.startsWith('/verify/')) {
    S.token = token;
    showScreen('processing', { token });
  } else if (token) {
    S.token = token;
    try {
      const d = await apiFetch(`/build-status?token=${token}`, {}, { retries: 0 });
      S.slug = d.slug || null;

      const dest = {
        live: 'dashboard',
        paid_pending: 'processing',
        preview_ready: 'experience',
        ready: 'experience',
        paid: 'processing',
        building: 'init',
        queued: 'init',
        lead: 'init'
      }[d.status] || 'init';

      showScreen(dest, { token, slug: d.slug });
    } catch (err) {
      logErr('Bootstrap status check failed', err);
      showScreen('init', { token });
    }
  } else if (slug) {
    S.slug = slug;
    showScreen('experience', { slug });
  } else {
    // No context — dev mode
    showScreen('init', { token: 'dev' });
  }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  closePopover(); // Ensure popover is closed on load
  bootstrap();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

// ── PERSONALITY RESOLUTION ────────────────────────────────────
export function getPersonality(industryKey) {
  const category = INDUSTRY_PERSONALITY[industryKey] || 'trade_authority';
  return {
    category,
    ...PERSONALITY_GENOMES[category],
  };
}

// ── TYPOGRAPHY BY ID ──────────────────────────────────────────
export function getTypographyById(id) {
  return TYPOGRAPHY_DB.find(t => t.id === id) || TYPOGRAPHY_DB[1];
}


// ── INDUSTRY → PALETTE ROW MAPPING ───────────────────────────

function matchIndustryToRow(industry) {
  if (!industry) return 0;
  const k = industry.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z\s]/g, '');

  if (/plumb|electr|locksmith|hvac|geyser|handyman|pest|appli/.test(k)) return 55;
  if (/beauty|hair|nail|salon|spa|lash|brow|massage|wax/.test(k))       return 32;
  if (/restaurant|food|cater|bakery|cafe|coffee|cook|braai/.test(k))    return 34;
  if (/fitness|gym|train|sport|yoga|pilates/.test(k))                   return 35;
  if (/property|real estate|estate agent|realty/.test(k))               return 36;
  if (/legal|law|attorney|advocate|notary/.test(k))                     return 40;
  if (/build|construct|renovate|paint|tile|plaster|carpenter/.test(k))  return 51;
  if (/auto|car|mechanic|panel|tyre|vehicle/.test(k))                   return 52;
  if (/photo|photographer|studio/.test(k))                              return 53;
  if (/medical|doctor|clinic|health|physio|nurse/.test(k))             return 58;
  if (/dental|dentist|teeth/.test(k))                                   return 60;
  if (/florist|flower|plant|garden|nursery/.test(k))                    return 62;
  if (/event|wedding|party|function|stokvel/.test(k))                  return 39;
  if (/flooring|floor|carpet|vinyl|laminate/.test(k))                  return 51;
  if (/clean|maid|domestic|laundry/.test(k))                           return 31;
  if (/transport|logistics|courier|delivery|driver/.test(k))           return 31;
  if (/tutor|teach|educat|school|training/.test(k))                    return 5;
  if (/hardware|pharmacy|grocer|butcher|retail|shop|store/.test(k))   return 31;

  return 0; // generic fallback
}

// ── TYPOGRAPHY MATCHING ───────────────────────────────────────

function matchTypography(industry, vibe) {
  const signals = [
    ...(industry || '').toLowerCase().split(/[\s,\/]+/),
    ...(vibe     || '').toLowerCase().split(/[\s,\/]+/),
  ];

  let bestMatch = TYPOGRAPHY_DB[1]; // Modern Professional as default
  let bestScore = 0;

  for (const pairing of TYPOGRAPHY_DB) {
    const score = pairing.moods.filter(m =>
      signals.some(s => s.includes(m) || m.includes(s))
    ).length;
    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; bestMatch = pairing; }
  }

  return bestMatch;
}

// ── LANDING PATTERN SELECTION ─────────────────────────────────
// Always returns "Scroll-Triggered Storytelling" for Website Hub.
// This is locked in the spec. The data confirms it's the right pattern
// for service businesses: "Narrative increases time-on-page 3x."

function getLandingPattern() {
  return {
    id: 10,
    name: 'Scroll-Triggered Storytelling',
    sectionOrder: ['hero', 'about', 'services', 'why-us', 'testimonial', 'contact'],
    ctaPlacement: 'End of each chapter + Final climax CTA',
    colorStrategy: 'Progressive reveal. Each section distinct visual weight.',
    mobileNote: 'Simplify animations on mobile. Progress indicator optional.',
  };
}

// ── MAIN EXPORT ───────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * getDesignBrief — personality-driven design system
 * Routes industry → personality category → genome → palette + typography
 *
 * @param {string} industry  e.g. "flooring", "hair_salon", "plumbing"
 * @param {string} vibe      optional override (legacy support)
 * @returns {object} Complete design brief for build pipeline
 */
export function getDesignBrief(industry, vibe) {
  // Resolve personality from industry key
  const industryKey = normaliseIndustryKey(industry);
  const personality = getPersonality(industryKey);

  // Get palette from personality's preferred row
  const palette     = PALETTE_DB[personality.palette_row] || PALETTE_DB[0];

  // Get typography from personality's preferred id
  const typo        = getTypographyById(personality.typography_id);
  const landing     = getLandingPattern();

  return {
    palette: {
      primary:    palette.primary,
      onPrimary:  palette.onPrimary,
      secondary:  palette.secondary,
      accent:     palette.accent,
      bg:         palette.bg,
      fg:         palette.fg,
      card:       palette.card,
      muted:      palette.muted,
      mutedFg:    palette.mutedFg,
      border:     palette.border,
      ring:       palette.ring,
      notes:      palette.notes,
    },
    typography: {
      heading:    typo.heading,
      body:       typo.body,
      name:       typo.name,
      cssImport:  typo.import,
    },
    // Full personality genome — drives renderer
    personality,
    landing,
    uxRules: UX_RULES,
    unsplashQuery: buildUnsplashQuery(industry, vibe, palette),
    _source:       `personality:${personality.category} palette:${personality.palette_row}`,
    industryKey,
  };
}

// ── INDUSTRY KEY NORMALISER ───────────────────────────────────
// Converts free-text industry to a normalised key
function normaliseIndustryKey(industry) {
  if (!industry) return 'general';
  const k = industry.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z\s_]/g, '').trim();

  if (/plumb/.test(k))                    return 'plumbing';
  if (/electr/.test(k))                   return 'electrical';
  if (/aircon|hvac|air.con/.test(k))      return 'aircon';
  if (/handyman/.test(k))                 return 'handyman';
  if (/carpent|joinery/.test(k))          return 'carpentry';
  if (/paint(?!er.*photo)/.test(k))       return 'painting';
  if (/roof/.test(k))                     return 'roofing';
  if (/waterproof/.test(k))               return 'waterproofing';
  if (/pest|exterminat/.test(k))          return 'pest_control';
  if (/appliance|whitegoods/.test(k))     return 'appliance_repair';
  if (/floor|carpet|vinyl|laminate/.test(k)) return 'flooring';
  if (/hair.*salon|salon|hairdress/.test(k)) return 'hair_salon';
  if (/barber/.test(k))                   return 'barber';
  if (/nail/.test(k))                     return 'nails';
  if (/spa|massage/.test(k))              return 'spa';
  if (/lash/.test(k))                     return 'lashes';
  if (/makeup|make.up|cosmetic/.test(k))  return 'makeup';
  if (/restaurant|diner/.test(k))         return 'restaurant';
  if (/cater/.test(k))                    return 'catering';
  if (/baker/.test(k))                    return 'bakery';
  if (/cafe|coffee/.test(k))              return 'cafe';
  if (/street.food|food.stall/.test(k))   return 'street_food';
  if (/chicken|kfc|chick/.test(k))        return 'chicken_shop';
  if (/shisa|nyama|braai/.test(k))        return 'shisa_nyama';
  if (/gym|fitness/.test(k))             return 'gym';
  if (/personal.train/.test(k))           return 'personal_trainer';
  if (/yoga|pilates/.test(k))             return 'yoga';
  if (/mechanic|auto.repair/.test(k))     return 'mechanic';
  if (/panel|body.shop/.test(k))          return 'panel_beater';
  if (/tyre|tire/.test(k))               return 'tyres';
  if (/carwash|car.wash/.test(k))         return 'carwash';
  if (/bakkie.hire|truck.hire/.test(k))   return 'bakkie_hire';
  if (/construct|build/.test(k))          return 'construction';
  if (/renovat/.test(k))                  return 'renovation';
  if (/plaster/.test(k))                  return 'plastering';
  if (/weld/.test(k))                     return 'welding';
  if (/sign/.test(k))                     return 'signage';
  if (/cctv|camera/.test(k))              return 'cctv';
  if (/clean|maid|domestic/.test(k))      return 'cleaning';
  if (/laundry/.test(k))                  return 'laundry';
  if (/medical|doctor|clinic/.test(k))    return 'medical';
  if (/pharm/.test(k))                    return 'pharmacy';
  if (/physio/.test(k))                   return 'physio';
  if (/dental|dentist/.test(k))           return 'dental';
  if (/property|estate.agent|realtor/.test(k)) return 'property';
  if (/legal|law|attorney|advocate/.test(k))   return 'legal';
  if (/account|bookkeep/.test(k))         return 'accounting';
  if (/crypto|blockchain/.test(k))        return 'crypto';
  if (/it.support|tech.support/.test(k))  return 'it_support';
  if (/social.media/.test(k))             return 'social_media';
  if (/graphic|design/.test(k))           return 'graphic_design';
  if (/securi/.test(k))                   return 'security';
  if (/spaza|tuck.shop/.test(k))          return 'spaza';
  if (/hardware/.test(k))                 return 'hardware';
  if (/bottle.store|liquor/.test(k))      return 'bottle_store';
  if (/wedding/.test(k))                  return 'wedding';
  if (/photo/.test(k))                    return 'photography';
  if (/\bdj\b|disc.jockey/.test(k))       return 'dj';
  if (/event/.test(k))                    return 'events';
  if (/transport|logistics/.test(k))      return 'transport';
  if (/kombi|minibus/.test(k))            return 'kombi';
  if (/landscap/.test(k))                 return 'landscaping';
  if (/garden|nursery/.test(k))           return 'garden';
  if (/florist|flower/.test(k))           return 'florist';
  if (/childcare|creche|daycare/.test(k)) return 'childcare';
  if (/tutor|teach|educat/.test(k))       return 'tutoring';
  if (/funeral/.test(k))                  return 'funeral';
  if (/ai.consult/.test(k))               return 'ai_consulting';

  return 'general';
}

// ── UNSPLASH KEYWORD QUERY BUILDER ───────────────────────────
// No collections. Full Unsplash archive keyword search only.
// Query is derived from: industry keyword + vibe modifier + palette mood.
// Substance build Pass 1 generates its own richer query from full card data —
// this function serves the pre-build and as a fallback.

const VIBE_MODIFIERS = {
  bold:         'dramatic powerful confident',
  warm:         'warm inviting natural light',
  professional: 'professional clean modern',
  playful:      'bright vibrant energetic',
  luxury:       'luxury premium elegant',
  minimal:      'minimal clean simple',
};

const INDUSTRY_PHOTO_TERMS = {
  plumb:        'plumber pipes professional trade',
  electr:       'electrician wiring professional trade',
  hvac:         'hvac technician professional',
  handyman:     'handyman tools professional repair',
  beauty:       'beauty salon interior professional',
  hair:         'hair salon stylist professional',
  nail:         'nail salon beauty professional',
  spa:          'spa wellness interior calm',
  restaurant:   'restaurant interior food professional',
  food:         'food catering professional kitchen',
  cafe:         'cafe coffee interior warm',
  bakery:       'bakery pastry interior warm',
  fitness:      'gym fitness training professional',
  gym:          'gym weights fitness professional',
  yoga:         'yoga studio calm wellness',
  property:     'real estate property modern interior',
  estate:       'real estate property professional',
  legal:        'law office professional authority',
  attorney:     'attorney law professional',
  construct:    'construction site building professional',
  build:        'builder construction professional site',
  flooring:     'flooring installation craftsman professional',
  tile:         'tiling installation professional craftsman',
  renovate:     'renovation interior professional',
  auto:         'automotive workshop professional mechanic',
  mechanic:     'mechanic workshop car professional',
  panel:        'panel beater workshop professional',
  medical:      'medical clinic professional clean',
  doctor:       'doctor clinic professional health',
  dental:       'dental clinic professional clean',
  clean:        'cleaning professional service spotless',
  domestic:     'cleaning service professional home',
  photo:        'photographer studio professional creative',
  florist:      'florist flowers professional shop',
  garden:       'garden nursery plants professional',
  event:        'event venue professional setup',
  wedding:      'wedding venue professional elegant',
  transport:    'transport logistics professional driver',
  tutor:        'education tutoring professional classroom',
};

function buildUnsplashQuery(industry, vibe, palette) {
  const k = (industry || '').toLowerCase();

  // Find the most specific industry photo term
  let industryTerm = 'professional service business south africa';
  for (const [fragment, term] of Object.entries(INDUSTRY_PHOTO_TERMS)) {
    if (k.includes(fragment)) { industryTerm = term; break; }
  }

  // Layer in vibe modifier if available
  const vibeMod = VIBE_MODIFIERS[(vibe || '').toLowerCase()] || '';

  // Combine — keep under 100 chars for Unsplash API
  const query = [industryTerm, vibeMod, 'south africa']
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' ')
    .slice(0, 100)
    .trim();

  return query;
}

// ── CSS VARIABLES GENERATOR ───────────────────────────────────

/**
 * buildCssVariables — generates the :root CSS block from a palette
 * Ready to inject directly into the HTML <head>
 * primaryColour (optional) — hex from Claude's palette decision or logo extraction
 * accentColour (optional)  — hex for CTAs and highlights from Claude's decision
 */
export function buildCssVariables(palette, typography, primaryColour = null, accentColour = null) {
  // Claude's chosen colours override primary/accent only
  // All other colours come from the palette naturally — light or dark as designed
  const primary = primaryColour || palette.primary;
  const accent  = accentColour  || primaryColour || palette.accent;

  return `<style id="wh-design-system">
${typography.cssImport}
:root {
  --primary:      ${primary};
  --on-primary:   ${palette.onPrimary};
  --accent:       ${accent};
  --bg:           ${palette.bg};
  --surface:      ${palette.muted};
  --card:         ${palette.card};
  --card-solid:   ${palette.muted};
  --fg:           ${palette.fg};
  --muted-fg:     ${palette.mutedFg};
  --border:       ${palette.border};
  --label-color:  ${palette.mutedFg};
  --font-heading: '${typography.heading}', serif;
  --font-body:    '${typography.body}', sans-serif;
}
</style>`;
}

/**
 * tintDark — mixes a hex colour into near-black at low opacity
 * Creates distinct dark backgrounds with subtle brand personality
 * intensity 0.07 = subtle, 0.14 = noticeable
 */
function tintDark(hex, intensity) {
  try {
    const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16);
    const g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16);
    const b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
    const base = 8; // near-black base
    const tr = Math.round(base + (r - base) * intensity);
    const tg = Math.round(base + (g - base) * intensity);
    const tb = Math.round(base + (b - base) * intensity);
    return `#${tr.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')}${tg.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')}${tb.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  } catch {
    return '#0a0a0a';
  }
}
